subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should ambiguous owner-qualified verdicts be solved by extending ClawHub's bulk contract, or should OpenClaw add a per-skill owner-qualified verification fallback?
rationale: The original trust-surface design intentionally avoided N per-skill requests, while the current bulk service does not demonstrate owner-aware resolution; changing that boundary or fallback policy requires explicit ownership intent.

options.title: Extend the bulk contract
options.body: Add owner-aware resolution to ClawHub, document and test it there, then keep OpenClaw's single bulk-request architecture.

options.title: Add an OpenClaw fallback
options.body: Fall back to owner-qualified single verification for ambiguous or not-found items, accepting extra requests and a second verdict path.

options.title: Merge transport only
options.body: Land the payload change without endpoint proof, leaving the reported user-visible failure unresolved until an external service change appears.

recommendation.title: Extend the bulk contract
recommendation.body: Add owner-aware resolution to ClawHub, document and test it there, then keep OpenClaw's single bulk-request architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the bulk verdict architecture and documented the deliberate no-per-skill-fallback boundary.
